entries.title: Mark 15:1
segments: As soon as it was down, after the high priests had conferred with the elders and the whole Sanhedrin, they bound Jesus, and took him away, and handed him over to Pilate.

entries.title: Mark 15:2
segments: Pilate questioned him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" In reply Jesus said, "It is as you say."

entries.title: Mark 15:3
segments: When the chief priests continued making many accusations against him, Pilate repeatedly questioned him.

entries.title: Mark 15:4
segments: "Do you make no answer?" he said,

entries.title: Mark 15:5
segments: "See, how many accusations they are making." But Jesus no longer made any answer, at which Pilate wondered.

entries.title: Mark 15:6
segments: Now at the time of the feast it was customary to release to them a prisoner, whatever one they asked for.

entries.title: Mark 15:7
segments: A man named Barabbas was there in prison, with some rioters who had committed murder during an uprising.

entries.title: Mark 15:8
segments: So when the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to follow his usual custom,

entries.title: Mark 15:9
segments: he asked them, "Do you wish me to release the King of the Jews?"

entries.title: Mark 15:10
segments: For he recognized that it was through spite that the high priests had handed him over.

entries.title: Mark 15:11
segments: But the chief priests incited the crowds to have Barabbas released to them, instead.

entries.title: Mark 15:12
segments: So Pilate spoke to them once more, "What them shall I do to him you call 'King of the Jews'?"

entries.title: Mark 15:13
segments: Then they shouted again, "Crucify him!"

entries.title: Mark 15:14
segments: "Why, what wrong has he done?" Pilate kept saying. But they shouted furiously, "Crucify him!"

entries.title: Mark 15:15
segments: So Pilate, who wished to make himself strong with the crowd, released Barabbas to them, and gave Jesus over for crucifixion, after he had scourged him.

entries.title: Mark 15:16
segments: The soldiers then led him away into the courtyard (Praetorium), and called together the whole battalion.

entries.title: Mark 15:17
segments: They clothed Jesus in purple, and plaited a crown of thorns, and placed it on his head.

entries.title: Mark 15:18
segments: Then they began to salute him. "Hail, King of the Jews," they said.

entries.title: Mark 15:19
segments: They kept striking him on the head with a rod, and spitting upon him; and on bended knee they did him homage.

entries.title: Mark 15:20
segments: And after their sport with him, they stripped off the purple robe, and put on his own clothes, and led him out to crucify him.

entries.title: Mark 15:21
segments: Simon a Cyrenian, a passer-by, who was coming from the country (the father of Alexander and Rufus), they commandeered to carry the cross of Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 15:22
segments: So they led him to the place called Golgotha--a name which means "the place of a skull."

entries.title: Mark 15:23
segments: There they attempted to give him wine mingled with myrrh; but he refused it.

entries.title: Mark 15:24
segments: Then they crucified him, and divided his garments among them, casting lots upon them to see what each should take.

entries.title: Mark 15:25
segments: It was nine o'clock in the morning when they crucified him.

entries.title: Mark 15:26
segments: Over his head there was written the words of the charge against him: "The King of the Jews"

entries.title: Mark 15:27
segments: Now with him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand and one on his left.

entries.title: Mark 15:29
segments: And the passers-by kept jeering at him, wagging their heads and saying: "Ah! you who were to 'destroy the sanctuary and rebuild it in three days,' save yourself!

entries.title: Mark 15:30
segments: Come down from the cross!

entries.title: Mark 15:31
segments: In the same way the high priests also, as well as the Scribes, kept on mocking him to themselves. "He saved others," they said, "but himself he cannot save.

entries.title: Mark 15:32
segments: The Christ! The King of Israel! Let him now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe." They also who had been crucified with Jesus kept reviling him.

entries.title: Mark 15:33
segments: At noon a darkness came over the whole country, lasting until three in the afternoon.

entries.title: Mark 15:34
segments: At three o'clock Jesus cried in a loud voice, @"Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?"@ which means, @"My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?"@

entries.title: Mark 15:35
segments: When they heard this, some of the bystanders said, "Listen, he is calling for Elijah."

entries.title: Mark 15:36
segments: Then a man ran and filled a sponge full of sour wine, and put it on a stick, and offered it to him to drink, saying, "Wait, let us see whether Elijah will come to take him down!"

entries.title: Mark 15:37
segments: But Jesus uttered a loud cry and expired.

entries.title: Mark 15:38
segments: And the curtain of the Sanctuary was torn in two from top to bottom.

entries.title: Mark 15:39
segments: Then the army captain, who was standing facing Jesus when he thus died, said, "in truth this man was a Son of God."

entries.title: Mark 15:40
segments: There were some women also watching from a distance. Among them were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses, and Salome,

entries.title: Mark 15:41
segments: women who used to follow him when he was in Galilee, and minister to him; and many other women who had come up to Jerusalem with him.

entries.title: Mark 15:42
segments: Toward sunset, as it was the preparation (that is the day preceding the Sabbath),

entries.title: Mark 15:43
segments: there came Joseph of Arimathea, a Councilor, honorable in rank, who was himself also looking for the kingdom of God. He boldly went in to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 15:44
segments: But Pilate wondered whether he were already dead. So he summoned the army captain, and inquired if he had been any time dead;

entries.title: Mark 15:45
segments: and when he learned the fact from the army captain he gave the body to Joseph.

entries.title: Mark 15:46
segments: So Joseph bought him a sheet, and took Jesus down, wound him in the sheet, and laid him in a tomb which had been hewn out of a rock, and then rolled a stone against the opening of the tomb;

entries.title: Mark 15:47
segments: and Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses were watching to see where he was laid.
